title: Matching generation requests share the work
summary:
Concurrent generation requests can share a result, three community projects joined the listings, and the unified API got clearer documentation.

Enter’s generation proxy now deduplicates concurrent matching requests, returning one generation result to each caller. Later responses carry `X-Cache: HIT` and `X-Cache-Type: DEDUP` headers; sequential requests still run separately.

The community project lists gained Nosde Space, which brings several creative tools together; TeleChars AI, for building Telegram characters; and Imgoo, for generating and editing images. Three quite different answers to “what can I build?”

A generated Markdown reference now covers the unified API with quick-start requests and endpoint schemas. The README points developers toward that API, while the OpenAPI spec is 13.5% smaller after repeated schemas were consolidated. The older image and text endpoints are documented as slated for future deprecation.

highlights.title: Shared concurrent generations
highlights.text: Send matching generation requests concurrently and Enter’s proxy shares one result between them. Later responses include `X-Cache: HIT` and `X-Cache-Type: DEDUP` headers. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
